resumen: With one knee and one hand on the bench, the dumbbell is pulled up to the hip with the elbow close to the body. It works the lats and mid-back one side at a time.
ejecucion: Put the knee and hand of the same side on the bench, torso almost horizontal.
Keep the other foot on the floor, slightly out, and let the dumbbell hang under the shoulder.
Pull the dumbbell up towards the hip, driving the elbow back and close to the body.
Lower it under control until the arm is straight, without twisting the torso.
matices: The review on the lats finds no clear differences between rows or between grips. What does change activation is the path the load takes relative to the body.
